tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /zhib mo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti siddhi rastu/gang zhig dngos kun 'dab brgya las/ /ye shes sbrang rtsir spyod byed pa/
༄༅/ /zhib mo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ swā sti siddhi rastu/gang zhig dngos kun 'dab brgya las/ /ye shes sbrang rtsir spyod byed pa/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhib mo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti siddhi rastu/ gang zhig dngos kun 'dab brgya las/ /ye shes sbrang rtsir spyod byed pa/ /de la 'khrul bar sems byed na/ /rigs pas 'bad de gsal bar bya/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i sde snod kyang*/ /mdor na rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /rgyu yi theg pa'i sde snod dang*/ /'bras bu rig 'dzin sde snod do/ / dang po'ang rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam/ /rdzogs dang ma rdzogs dbye ba yis/ /pha rol phyin dang theg dman gyi/ /sde snod gnyis su bstan pa yin/ /bdag nyid nges par 'byung 'dod dang*/ /'gro ba sgrol 'dod blo chen dang*/ /shin tu dbang po rnon po yis/ /gdul bya rnams la dgongs nas ni/ /nyan thos pha rol phyin pa dang*/ /sngags kyi theg pa bstan pa yin/ /tshegs chung dus ni myur ba ru/ /byang chub thob 'dod de dbang rno/ /sku yi rnam pa mi sgom zhing*/ /bde ba dam pa med pas na/ /grangs med gsum du ngal byas kyang*/ /da dung mthar thug thob ma yin/ /mdo las bshad pa'i che ba dag /byang chub sems dpa' la yod min/ /de phyir tshul gnyis thob bya yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la khyad par med/ / sangs rgyas gnyis su 'dod na ni/ /theg pa bzhi pa cis ma yin/ /mthar thug theg pa gnyis su 'gyur/ /bzang ngan med na ci zhig khyad/ /cung zad mngon rtogs khyad yod kyang*/ /phal cher mtshungs phyir gcig ce na/ /nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal gyi/ /theg pa'ang gcig tu smra bar byos so/ /thob bya'i yul la khyad med kyang*/ /lam des thob dang mi thob khyad/ /rang bzhin stong nyid sgom tsam la'ang*/ khyad par yod pa ma yin no/ /pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs las/ / spros bral chos sku'i rnam pa dang*/ /mthun pa lam du byed mod kyi/ /gzugs sku'i rnam pa lam byed med/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas bde ba zhes/ /bshad kyang de yi lam ma bstan/ /'bras bu rgyu las gzhan min phyir/ /'di ni sngags kyi che ba yin/ /sbyin sogs bsod nams tshogs rdzogs shing*/

/smon lam mthu las gzugs kyi sku/ /'byung bar 'gyur na chos sku yang*/ /smon lam mthu las cis mi 'byung*/ /goms pa sngon du ma gyur pas/ /de mi 'byung na gzugs sku yang*/ /'byung zhes brjod par nus ma yin/ /lha ru skye ba tshul khrims kyi/ /mthu las byung gi lha nyid dang*/ /rnam pa mthun pa ci zhig dgos/ /de phyir lhag pa min zhe na/ /skye 'di nyid la tshul khrims kyis/ /lha ru 'gyur ba 'ga' yang med/ /byis pa'i mig dag 'phel ba las/ /mthu ldan ring du mthong bar 'gyur/ /rnam smin rgyu ni 'ba' zhig gis/ /gzugs sku sgrub par 'dod pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bar srid nyid/ /longs spyod rdzogs par skyed byed dam/ /bsod nams rnam smin byed sems kyi/ /lus mchog mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'byung*/ /de yi rgyu mthun 'bras bu ni/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku kho na/ /'on kyang sgom pa med pa'i phyir/ /skye ba gcig la sku mi 'grub/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i sku sgom pa/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran yin gsungs na/ /lha yi rnam pa sngags bskyed 'di/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran cis ma yin/ /de phyir 'di ni bsten bya ste/ /pha rol phyin la med pas na/ /des kyang thabs mang nyid 'gyur te/ /de bstan gang yin 'di ru yod/ /stong nyid lha yi snang ba yis/ /tha mal snang ba 'gog byed de/ /rnam pa 'gal ba'i mthu nyid yin/ /sbyin sogs dge bas de ltar min/ /sems ni sgom pa'i gzugs su snang*/ /sems kyi tshul las lus 'grub pas/ /sgom pas tshe 'dir mi 'grub min/ /lhan skyes bag chags zlog pa'i phyir/ /stong nyid sgos kyi bde ba min/ /ji snyed shes phyir shes bya ni/ /kun la slob ces 'gal bar smra/ /stong nyid rang bzhin tshul zhugs na/ /bde ba'ang kun rdzob tshul la zhugs/ /de phyir sgom ste snying rje bzhin/ / sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /mi shes 'khrul phyir sdug bsngal na/

/shes na bde ba kun 'thob phyir/ /rang bzhin bde ba cis ma yin/ /mi rtag pa las sdug bsngal gyi/ /'du shes 'khrul med skye bar gsungs/ /rang bzhin 'jig med la bde ba'i/ /'du shes 'khrul ba med pa 'byung*/ /bde min bde bar 'du shes na/ /'du shes 'khrul ba ci phyir min/ /rten cing 'brel 'byung la sogs pa/ /ji snyed chos kun sgom byed na/ /bde ba kho nas ci zhig nyes/ /sngags dang las tshogs dngos grub sogs/ /thabs mang gzhan yang 'dir yod do/ /dka' ba med par myur 'grub pas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /'dod chags lam byed mi byed kyang*/ /mdo dang sngags kyi tshul la mthong*/ /sngags dang rgyu sbyor lam gyis ni/ /dngos gzhi ston dang mi ston khyad/ /bde dang myur ba'i khyad par gyi/ /rdo rje theg pa gtso bo'i gtso/ /dpal ldan rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /'di ni yongs su bstan pa yin/ /'di ni mdo sder shin tu rgyas/ /ma mo dang ni 'dul ba'ang yod/ /rig 'dzin sde snod gzhan zhig ni/ /ma mthong phyir na 'di kho na/ /drag shul bud med sbyor sngags sogs/ /'di dag thabs mkhas dag la gnang*/ /dgag bya gtso bor ldan pa na/ /sngags las kyang ni de dag bkag /byang chub sems la reg sogs las/ /ting 'dzin thob ces mdo las bshad/ /de dgug sngags bzlas sgrib byang ste/ /myur nas grol ba ston ces gsungs/ /33 rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par 'phags pa bstan pa ste le'u dang po'o// // lha yi rnal 'byor sogs bde ba/ /sgom gyi stong nyid de ltar min/ / gzugs kyi sku ni de yis 'grub/ /lta ngan rang bzhin shes pas bzlog /de nyid mi shes de skad smra/ /bdag 'dzin lhan skyes ma spangs na/ /thar ba thob pa ga la zhig /de yang rnam pa 'gal ba'i spongs/ /shes rab de nyid bsgom bya ste/ / gsal snang rab kyi mthar thug 'gyur/ /'di yis bdag 'dzin bzlog 'gyur gyi/ /rjes su dpag pa skyes pas min/

/yin na shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /'bad med grol bar mi 'gyur ram/ /chos sku ma sgom 'grub 'gyur na/ /gzugs kyi sku yang cis mi 'grub/ /gzugs sku chos sku med na min/ /sems kyi yon tan mthar thug pa/ /med par rnam smin mthar thug med/ /ye shes tshogs ni sgom byed na/ /bsod nams lhag par 'grub par 'gyur/ /shes rab sgom pa'i nyin gcig kyang*/ /gzhan gyis bskal pa du mar min/ kha cig rdzogs sangs rgyas pa yi/ /gnyis med ye shes rgyu mthun las/ /'byung phyir spros bral bsgom bya yi/ /thabs gzhan mkhas la mi dgos la/ /zab mos 'jigs rnams drang phyir dang*/ /skur 'debs chad lta dgag pa dang*/ /bzlas sgom zhi sogs bsgrub phyir te/ /mchog 'dod pa la de mi dgos/ /sprin dang byi ba dkar nag dpes/ /rnam rtog thams cad chos nyid la/ /shin tu sgrib byed yin no lo/ /'khrul shes phyir na rnam g.yeng can/ /rnam par rtog phyir ting 'dzin med/ /de ma yin la der 'dzin can/ /gsal bar snang la min zhes zer/ /rgyu mthun med na gnyis med kyi/ /ye shes nam yang 'byung med na/ /sngon nas 'gro kun 'phags par 'gyur/ /zhi sogs 'grub par mi 'gyur na/ /mchog 'dod 'di las tha shal ci/ /'grub na stong nyid ston par rigs/ /rnam rtog des ni mngon sum du/ /chos nyid mthong ba ma yin kyang*/ /rgyur 'gyur dad pa la sogs bzhin/ / kun rtog kun gyis sgrib ces btags/ /yang na mi rtog ye shes de/ /'bad med skyes nas kun grol 'gyur/ /'dun pa med na 'jog med pas/ /yang na nam yang skye mi srid/ /'dun sems kyis kyang cis mi sgrib/ /tha mar sgrib kyang re zhig de/ /mi rtog sgrub phyir rten zhe na/ /thabs gzhan dag kyang cis mi bsten/ /rig pas dpyod pa rnams la ni/ /dgra ltar lta ba kun la yang*/ /rig pa 'di ni 'jug 'gyur te/ /blo ldan rnams kyis dpyod par gyis/ /bskyed rim mtshan bcas rdzogs rim sogs/

/spros pa yin phyir spong pa dang*/ /g.yul dang bud med don gnyer sogs/ /rang ngo shes nas rung ngo zhes/ /'di 'dra'i tshig la'ang bden par 'dzin/ /phyogs 'di'i blun po ma gtogs pa/ /yul gzhan dag gi blun po yang*/ /'di la ga zhar cis mi byed/ /rang ngo shes na nyon mongs ni/ /blang du rung na spros bcas dge rang ngo shes pas cis mi byed/ /rang ngo shes pa mnyam po la/ /dge ba ci'i phyir na spong*/ /phung po rnam dpyad stong nyid ni/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyur ba min/ /sbyin sogs yongs su goms pa las/ /rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid 'grub/ /zab mo gcig pu sgom pas min/ /blo dman don du gsungs pa'i phyir/ /las dang po la dgos par grub/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba rtogs nas ni/ /bcos ma mi bya zhes gsungs la/ /chu yi pha rol ma phyin par/ /gru gzings 'dor ba blun po'i lugs/ /dge ba rtsa ba ma rdzogs par/ /stong pa'ang mthar phyin min zhes bstan/ /rnam par rtog cing ting 'dzin dag /'grub mi nus na zhi gnas kun/ /rang byung nyid du skye bar 'gyur/ /ting 'dzin phal gyi dmigs pa yang*/ /rnam par rtog dang bcas pa yin/ /don dam la ltos 'khrul spong na/ /sems dang sems byung kun 'khrul bas/ /'tshang rgya ba dag med par 'gyur/ /mi sdug zad par la sogs pa/ /log par 'khrul yang de bsgom bya/ /gsal bar snang ba mthong ba na/ /rtog las rtog med skye ba ste/ /'dod ldan rnams la chags yul bzhin/ /dpyod dang sgom pa 'bras dang bcas/ /bud med gzugs kyang 'dod ldan la/ /res 'ga' gsal gyi rtag min ltar/ /lha yang brtan par mi 'gyur min/ /de ni rnam g.yeng goms pa dang*/ /'di ni rtse gcig tshul gyis sgrubs/ /cha gcig mthong tshe gzhan min pas/ /sku yang 'grub pa med snyam na/ /so sor rtog pa gnyis med kyang*/ /gsal bar snang ba gcig char snang*/

/gcig car dbang shes lnga 'jug bzhin/ /rtog pas cig car mi 'dzin kyang*/ /de yi rgyud 'gyur shin tu yod/ /'khyud tshe 'o byed mi rig cing*/ /gdong ltas nu ma mi mthong sogs/ /mi mthong 'dod spyod med par 'gyur/ /kun rdzob don dam ma phyed par/ /lha dag dga' ba'i spyod la ltos/ /bsam pa gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /de de'i rang bzhin 'gyur lha mo/ /sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu 'dra/ /zhes pa'ang rung du gsungs pa yin/ /31 lam phyogs re ba dgag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //rdo rje theg pa 'di la ni/ /nyon mongs lam du byed mthong ste/ /mi mkhas nyon mongs spangs zin nas/ /nyon mongs lta bur spyod ces 'dod/ /bkag pa'ang spyod par gnang ba ste/ /rnal 'byor de nyid ldan gyur na/ /ngan zos ngan spyod thams cad kyang*/ /sgrib pa dag tu yongs mi 'gyur/ /'on kyang dmigs pa'i lta ba can/ /rab tu zhen pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyis ni/ /lung bzhin rigs pas gsal bor dbye/ /ded dpon snying rje chen po yis/ /thabs mkhas ldan pas g.yo can bsad/ /de yis bskal mang tshogs rdzogs shing*/ khye'u skar mar gyur ba'i tshe/ /tshong dpon bu mor longs spyod pa'ang*/ /byang chub nye ba'i mchog gyur ces/ /dngos po'i rang bzhin shes pa dang*/ /snying rje chen po'i mthu yang bstan/ /tshangs spyod lam gyis mngon par brgyan/ /bud med khrag khrig kun sems rgyu/ /chos rnga dbyangs chen rab sgrog pa/ /theg pa'i dam pas bdag bstan gsol/ /de skad sdong po bkod par gsungs/ /grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud/ /bu ram shing gi zhing la phan/ /byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /sangs rgyas chos kun skyed pa'i gzhi/ / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'dzin pas dug tu 'gyur ba yin/ /dug ni nye bar zhi gyur na/ /dug ni dug med byas pa yin/ /bdud rtsi rim gyis brten na ni/

/bdud rtsi nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /blun po gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /de yis mkhas pa yongs grol zhes/ /byang chub rnam par bsgom na ni/ /'di dag thams cad phyin ci log /gang gis rmongs pa 'ching 'gyur zhing*/ /ngu 'bod mtha' ni de 'gro ba/ /de nyid kyis ni grol gyur cing*/ /shes rab stobs kyis bde ba 'thob/ /yid 'ong bde ba'i 'bras bu ni/ /bla med gsal ba blo yis mthu/ /'bras bu don gnyer rgyu bsgrub na/ /der ni blo ldan su zhig 'gog /dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas/ /lus ni skams shing sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal gyis ni sems g.yeng te/ /g.yeng bas dngos grub gzhan du 'gyur/ /lus dang sems ni brtan byas na/ /bde ba thams cad brtan par 'gyur/ /lus dang ngag dang sems rnams ni/ /bde bar gnas na byang chub 'thob/ /gzhan du dus min 'chi ba dang*/ /dmyal bar nges par 'tshed par 'gyur/ /dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas/ /bsten pas 'grub par mi 'gyur gyi/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /bsten na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /bkag pa dag kyang byed pas na/ /bya dang bya min rnams spangs te/ /padma la ni 'dam gyis bzhin/ /ngo bo nyid shes gos mi 'gyur/ /chags pas 'jig rten 'ching 'gyur ba/ /'dod chags nyid kyi rnam grol 'gyur/ / 'dod chags rnyog med chags bral 'joms/ /bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed/ /gang zhig dge slong dngos gnas dang*/ /gang yang rtog ge la dga'i mi/ /gang zhig rgan por gnas gyur pa/ /de la de nyid bstan mi bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya gang spangs nas/ /byang chub sems ni rab brtan pa/ /gzhan gyis mtshon pas mi : [ thob ] mthong ste/ /dang po'i las pas rig bya ba/ /thog ma bar mtha' dri med pa/ /gnas te gzhan du nus ma yin/ /bdag tu dmigs par mi bya zhing*/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rang nyid bzhugs/ /de ltar bsam nas rnal 'byor gyis/

/dbang pos gang la'ang brnyas mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la dad cing gus/ /byang chub sems kyis rnam par brgyan/ /sems can kun la rjes su brtse/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom la gnas/ /gzhi mnyam khrag dang sha nyid dag /byang chub sems dang rab bsres la/ /chu chen dang ni yang dag ldan/ /de nyid rig pa'i rtag tu bza'/ /mi khyi rta dang ba lang sgron/ /sna chen dang ni khur bskyed kyi'ang*/ /rtog pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /de nyid grub phyir bza' bar bya/ /srid gsum las byung bsad bya zhing*/ /pha rol nor ni 'phrog pa dang*/ /gzhan gyi bud med la 'dod spyod/ / rdzun gyi tshig ni smra bar byed/ /thabs chen yang dag ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'jig rten don sgrub pa/ /de la bya ba mi bya med/ /shes rab thabs dang ldan pa la/ /sdig par grags pa yongs med ces/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid kyis gsung*/ /rnal 'byor pa yi sems sbyangs phyir/ /bu mo la sogs rjes su gnang*/ 27 /rtog pa'i chu yis gang ba yi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ni/ /rdo rje theg la ma zhon par/ /su zhig pha rol 'gro bar 'gyur/ /shin tu mi bsrun dgra bo dag kha cig gsug gis bslus byas te/ /dpa' bo g.yul du 'joms par byed/ /pho brang bsrung bas thul ma yin/ /'dod chags rtog pa thag bsrings pas/ /de 'joms shin tu nus ma yin/ /de nyid rang bzhin shes byas nas/ /drung du bsnyen pas 'joms par byed/ /'di ltar kun nas slong ba'i sems/ /nyon mongs can dang yul de la/ /de ru 'du shes ma 'khrul zhing*/ / bdag nyid dge slong 'du shes can/ /las de la yang der shes na/ /phas pham la sogs ltung ba zhes/ /dpang gyur mkhyen pa'i gzigs rnams gsungs/ / chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro zhing*/ /yid ni gtso bo yin zhes gsung sa/ /dge slong rang gi pha rgan la/ /myur ldong zhes ni bskul ba'i phyir/ /phul ba'i de ni shi gyur kyang*/ /mtshams med sbyor ba ma yin no/

/shin tu na ba'i dgra bcom pas/ /dge slong nad g.yog byed pa la/ /nga yi mgrin pa sdoms zhes bskul/ /de shi na yang skyon med bstan/ /'du shes gzhan gyis gzhan dag gi shi yang nyes de mi spyod par/ /'di 'dra lung las gsal bor bstan/ /de phyir sems dge nyes pa med/ /de 'dus bya ba'i blo yis ni/ /mchod rten bshigs kyang nyes med de/ /nye ba'i mtshams med byas pas kyang*/ /bsod nams phung po 'ba' zhig go /de phyir bsam pa'i rtsa ba la/ /bsod nams sdig pa rnam par gnas/ /dga' mgur spyod pa'i rmi lam dag /'dul la nyes pa med par bstan/ /dngos dang rmi lam dag tu yang*/ /sdig dang bsod nams kun mtshungs te/ /mos pas dge ba 'phel 'gyur sogs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin par gsungs/ /lus dang ngag gi spyod pa'i tshul/ /rmi lam snang ba 'bras med nyid/ /gang du yid kyis rnam g.yo ba/ /rmi lam sad la bye brag med/ /chos rnams rmi lam ltar shes na/ /lus ngag yid kyi nyes las grol/ /ser skya bzang mo dge slong ma/ /ma skyes dgra yis log zhugs kyang*/ /de la phas pham med par bstan/ /g.yo can lnga brgyas bsgrod gyur kyang*/ /dge slong ma ni bzang mo skyes/ /nyes pa med ces bstan pa yin/ /nyon mongs spangs pa ma yin kyang*/ /dge slong gnyid kyis non pa la/ /shing thun mo yis btsal ba yang*/ /ma tshor bas na nyes med gsungs/ /klu mo dang ni ce spyang mor/ /reg pa bdag gir ma byas te/ /'dod spyod pham par ma gyur pas/ /'khrig pa la dngos gtso bo ste/ /'du shes gtso bor med ces pa/ /dgos pa gzigs pas gsungs pa ste/ /sngaun gyi bstan la bud med dag /rab byung dgag bya med ces pa'ang*/ / dngos po dag la khyad med pas/ /bsam dang 'du shes khyad par bstan/ / 'jig rten sna tshogs 'dod min gyi/ /'dod pas kun rtog yin pas na/ / 'jig rten sna tshogs gnas kyang ni/ /brtan rnams 'dun pa 'dul zhes gsungs/

/rang bzhin shes pas 'dod yon la/ /spyod pa mdo sder rjes su gnang*/ /'du shes rnam par bshig byas la/ /bdag dang gzhan du mi shes pas/ /de la der shes rnam par log /yul dang yul min mnyam sgom pas/ yul la nges pa'i 'du shes med/ /gang yang rnam par rtog med pa/ /de la nyes pa yod min te/ /ji ltar sems med shing sogs bzhin/ /rgyu yi dus na 'dod chags dag /yod kyang nyes 'gyur ma yin te/ /'dod chags ldan pa gnyid log bzhin/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bas/ /dge slong dge bsnyen khyim pa dang*/ /bud med sogs su 'du mi shes/ /rdo shing 'du shes bud med la/ /reg pa nyes med 'dul las bstan/ /rdzaugs sangs rgyas su 'du shes na/ /ci phyir nyes pa bstan par 'dod/ /ji ltar snang ba thams cad ni/ /'khrul ba nyid du rnam gnas shing*/ /ci tsam 'du shes kun 'khrul na/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul rnam phye ba'ang*/ /nges don mi shes ngor gsungs pa'o/ /de nyid rig la 'du shes med/ /'du shes thams cad 'khrul bar mthong*/ /'dod la dga' ba ma yin te/ /bde ba'i phyir ni bsten pa dang*/ /rang gi lha yi bdag nyid sbyor/ /rnam par mi rtog dmigs su med/ /bde ba rang bzhin med shes shing*/ /las la'ang der shes yod min la/ /mchod dang lam du mngon par rtogs/ /snying rje che dang yi rang dang*/ /yongs su bsngo dang byang chub sems/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje ba dang*/ /spros dang bral ba'i shes rab kyi/ /dgag bya dgos pa'i dbye shes pas/ /thabs mkhas khyad par 'byung ba ni/ /theg chen kun las mthun par bshad/ /de dag kun yang 'di la yod/ /nyes spyod sdom las mi ldog pas/ /so sor thar pa rnams nyams med/ /grub pa mkhas pa mang po dag /dgos pa chen po mthong bas na/ /rtags tsam phul ba nyid yin gyi/ /de yi sdom pa phul ba med/ /chos kun sgyu mar mthong ba dang*/ /'bul sems ji bzhin med phyir ro/ / grub pa rnams la nyes med pas/

/de phyir sems nyid gtso bo yin/ /'dod chags dag pa 'ba' zhig la/ /phyag rgya gsungs pa ma yin te/ /'dod chags lta bu'i bde ba med/ /de ni sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /'dod chags lam du byed ces pa/ /med na ci zhig lam du byed/ /bde ba chen po mi sgrub na/ /sgrub po re zhig 'dod mas ci/ /nyan thos bzhin du chags bral na/ /'dod pas bde ba ji ltar bskyed/ /bde ba'i ye shes bsgrub bya'i phyir/ /'dod ldan rnams la gsungs pa yin/ /nyon mongs mngon gyur spang dgos na/ /nyon mongs lam byed tshig tsam nyid/ /nyon mongs che zhing lam myur la/ /snying rje nges 'byung sogs kyang che/ /rang gi sems nyid yongs dag na/ /rnam kun rdzogs par byang chub pas/ /sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir/ /phyag rgya bzhi po bsgrub par bya/ /'di ltar 'dod la longs spyod pa/ /zhen pa med pas rnyed pa'am/ /ye shes sgrub la gnang ba yin/ /gang zag dbang po dul ba 'am/ /tshegs med rnyed par gyur nani/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas dang*/ khang mig lnga brgya pa yang snang*/ /lha las tshe 'phos dge slong la/ /yo byad lhag por snang ba dang*/ /dri zhim la sogs rnam g.yengs rgyu/ /skabs 'gar rtse gcig rgyun yang bstan/ /chags can 'dod yon las gzhan pas/ /sems ni rtse gcig thob pa med/ /bde la zhen par mi byed do/ /gdung ba zhi ba'i rtse gcig 'thob/ /ji ltar khrus mkhan dri ma yis/ /gos kyi dri ma med par byed/ /li khri'i rdul gyis me long gi /dri ma dag par 'gyur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin mkhas pas nyes pa dag /sbyangs phyir nyes pa bsten par bya/ /shes rab thabs kyis sems 'di yis/ /nyes pa'i ri bo bcom nas ni/ /bdag dang gzhan yang sgrol bar byed/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams gyis/ /dbang po brtas par byed par 'gyur/ /de las byang chub sems rgyas shing*/ /de yis bde ba 'phel bar 'gyur/ /reg pa'i bde las yid bde

bskyed/ /yid ni bde bar gyur pa na/ /dbang po rnams kyang bde bar 'gyur/ /ngo bo nyid kyi bud med las/ /rnam par mi rtog skye bar 'gyur/ /bde bas sems ni sdud byed cing*/ /bde dang rnam par mi rtog pas/ /de nyid mthar thug yang dag rig /nyon mongs zhes dang las 'di yang*/ /'khor bar ltung bar byed pa dang*/ /byang chub mchog gi rgyur 'gyur bas/ /nyon mongs nyid kyi skyon ma yin/ /dngos por 'dzin pa de yi skyon/ /dug gis 'chi bar byed ces pas/ /dug nyid kho na'i skyon ma yin/ /'chi byed nus pa med pa'i skyon/ /gzhan du rma bya lus rgyas byed/ /pha rol phyin pa'i bstan bcos las/ /skyon du lta zhing spyod par gsungs/ /'dir ni bde ba che don du/ /ye shes rgyu yi phyir du bsten/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sku yang 'grub/ /sems kyi rang bzhin gsal bar mtshon/ /rlung gi g.yo ba thim par 'gyur/ /de phyir de nyid rig pa yi/ /yidani gzhan du ma gyur pas/ /'dod can ma la 'dod spyad na/ /'dod dang thar ba 'grub par 'gyur/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo dge slong la/ /bkag na sngags spyod des 'dul gyi/ /gtso bo'i gdul bya la med pa'am/ /yang na khyim pa gtso bor 'gyur/ /kun spangs khyim pa ga la zhig /tshangs spyod bla mar gsang dbang dang*/ /slob mar shes rab ye shes ni/ /las dang po la dngos bkag cing*/ /de nyid rig la nyes med gsungs/ /'di ni mtha' yi gsal byed yin/ /'khor lo'i mchod sogs dge slong dang*/ khyim pa'i dbye ba mi rung ste/ /gsum las dge slong mchog yin no/ /21 'dod yon lam byed sgrub pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //bzhi pa don dam ye shes ni/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi bgrod gcig lam/ / las rgya'i bde ba de nyid min/ /'byung ba'i bde ba 'jig rten de/ /don dam 'jig tshogs la ma brten/ /rkyen gyi glo bur 'byung mthong zhing*/ /chags bcas ngal dang rtsol bar bcas/

/lus la nye tsher khyab pa'i phyir/ /rang bzhin zag med lhun grub dang*/ /kun tu khyab pa ma yin no/ /sems kyi rang bzhin bde 'diyin/ /rtog bcas stong pa'ang de min te/ /rtog dang bcas phyir gnyis su snang*/ /de phyir yang dag don las log /rmongs par 'jig pa'ang bya kun la/ /rmongs na zab mor lta ci smos/ /dbang po nye tshe ba yi yul/ /las kyang nyi tshes byed pa'i phyir/ /bskyed rim sku ni nye tshe yin/ /rtog pa'i ngo bor snang ba las/ /med phyir rdo rje'i sku ma yin/ /sems las dngos su grub pa'i sku/ /kun khyab zhen med sems bde ba/ /rang bzhin phyir na bde mi 'gyur/ /rang bzhin stong par gsal snang can/ /lus sems ngo bo gcig gyur pa/ /'di ni don dam bzhi pa'i dbang*/ ngo bo bde dang rang bzhin med/ /gsal cha 'gag med ye shes te/ /de ltar de nyid de ye shes/ /de ltar rnal 'byor ma mtshan nyid/ /dam tshig la zhen mkhas pa dang*/ /rlung gi de nyid pha rol son/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i don bslabs pa/ /ngag 'jam shes rab ldan ma dang*/ /mig yangs mi yi bu mo rnyed/ /gzugs dang lang tshos rnam par brgyan/ /ji bzhin rnal 'byor dam tshig la/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub par byed/ /de nas de nyid thob pa ni/ /phyag rgyas chen po'i mtshad nyid do/ /de nyid bde chen go 'phang ni/ /kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /stong nyid ye shes dri ma med/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi go 'phang gsal/ /las dang po la mtshon pa ni/ /gcig tu nges pa yod min pas/ /slob dpon kun gyi gzhung lugs kyi/ /rtsod pa rab tu zhi ba yin/ /don dam skyes pa med pa la/ /dbang po gnyis skyes der 'dod dang*/ /gnyid 'thug bzhi par 'dod pa dang*/ /'dir yang dpyod par 'dod pa 'khrul/ /'on kyang mi mo las mtshon cing*/ /lha dang mi rtog rgyas gdab byed/ /de dag dper byas go ba la/ / bzhi pa bskur zhes bshad pa yin/ /zhu ba phyag rgya'i dbang yid kyis/

/rung na chu sogs cis ma yin/ /dbye par ma nus bsam gtan gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ting 'dzin dam rgyas bya/ kha cig mdo dang sngags dag kyang*/ /mtha' yas phyir na thabs mnyam zhing*/ /rkang lag gtong la'ang zhum med pas/ /dka' ba med par mnyam zhes 'dod/ /sde snod min na sngags kyis ci/ /yin na sde snod gsum gyis chog /drod thob bskal pa grangs med ni/ /gsum yang skad cig gsum yin te/ /rtag tu ngu bzhin tshe gcig la/ /sangs rgyas mdo las nges par yod/ /gsang sngags drang don mdo sde ni/ /nges don yin zhes smra bar byed/ /mi dang ngan song gnyis ka yang*/ /mtha' yas phyir na mnyam par 'gyur/ /dga' ba tshor ba sdug bsngal te/ /de med na ni gzhan don du/ /rang bde khyad du bsad mi 'gyur/ /tshor ba bde ba 'dir lam byed/ /rin chen min na gser gyis ci/ /yin na dngul gyis chog ces pa/ /mi mkhas lugs la su zhig brton/ /skad cig bskal par ston na yang*/ /skad cig bskal pa nyid ma yin/ /de phyir skad cig gsum kho nas/ /grangs med gsum gyi tshogs mi rdzogs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas dam bca' tsam/ /mthun pa'i dpe yang ma grub po/ /stong nyid sngags las rgya cher bstan/ /mdo sde nyi tshe 'ga' zhig las/ /dgongs pa gzhan du drangs yang dgos/ /tshig rnams phal cher thabs nyid ston/ /gnyis ka'ang gnyis ka gnas bzhin du/ /phyogs su lhung bar ma gyur cig /sgrub dka' nyams na nyes che bas/ /so skyes sngags spyod dus min lo/ /g.yul du 'jug dang bsod nams dang*/ /nor bu'i gling du 'gro la spros/ /dge slong sdom dang sems bskyed len/ /'di la'ang de yis dgag par gyis/ /dgag bya yod kyang dgos che bas/ kho bo sngags la 'jug par byed/ /rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' la/ /sngags rgyud brten pa bde bar 'grub/ /bskal pa gsum du ngal byas kyang*/ /byang chub sgrub par mi nus pa/ /lus gcig la yang thob pa ni/ /sngags shes rnams kyis byas pa

yin/ /rig sngags med rnams thams cad du/ /dka' ba kho na 'phel bar mthong*/ /tshul min yid byed phyir mnyam sbyor/ /dge slong gis sgom mi rung zer/ /rgyan gyis sgeg dang mtshon 'dzin sogs/ /rang nyid sgom la'ang de skyon yod/ khrus dang gtsang sbra zhes pa dang*/ /rigs dang rigs min zhes pa yang*/ /de nyid ma rig rnams kyi tshul/ /mi gtsang rdzas nyid mi gtsang na/ /khrus kyis dag par ci ste 'gyur/ /mi gtsang phur ma bkrus pa bzhin/ /mi gtsang ba yi gong bur gnas/ /ci tsam lus nyid de mi gtsang*/ /yul dang rigs chos tha dad phyir/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang rtog par zad/ /gdol ba'i rigs kyang dka' thub kyis/ /drang srong chen por 'gyur zhes gda'/ /dge dang mi dge las gzhan pa'i/ /rigs la bye brag rigs mi 'grub/ /bdun pa gnyen 'dun nyid yin na/ /brgyad pa'ang ci yi phyir ma yin/ /de bzhin grangs med par du bsgre/ /de phyir gnyen sogs btags par zad/ /'gro ba thams cad pha dang ma/ /de la nye ring dbye ba med/ /sems nyid ma dang bur gyur la/ /gnyen mi 'thad na lus brten pa'i/ /pha ma bu yi 'brel mi 'thad/ /der 'gyur sems kyi'ang cis mi 'gyur/ /sgron ma lnga sogs bza' min la/ /de dag bza' bar mngon shes dag /med pa'i rgyud 'grel mkhan smra mod/ /de yis 'grel byed mi rung lo/ /de lta na ni mngon shes dag /med par rgyud kyang bshad mi 'os/ /log par bris phyir nyes bcas na/ /log par bshad la'ang cis mi nyes/ /ma nor bris pa'ang nyes pa ci/ /dgra bcom mngon shes drug ldan yang*/ /theg pa 'di la rnal 'byor rmongs/ /mngon shes ldan yang lha chen po/ /'di ru byol song yin zhes gsungs/ /'gyur bcas phyir na rgyas pa sogs/ /mngon shes med ces bya ba dang*/ /bde ba ches drangs mngon shes te/ /'di yod dang por 'grel byed nus/ /de'i rjes 'brangs pas gzhan gyis kyang*/ /ci phyir 'grel pa byed mi

nus/ /sgrub thabs chog sogs kyang de bzhin/ /bza' bya'ang las dang po la gnang*/ /dam tshig phyir na bsten bya yin/ /yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam bsten sogs kyis/ /las dang po la cis mi 'grub/ /'gro la phan don gdul phyir yin/ /'o ma 'thung sogs klu mo dag /'grub kyi gzhan du nyon mongs zhes/ /gsungs pa'ang las dang po la dgongs/ /des de 'grub na gzhan cis min/ /thams cad bza' la nus pa mthong*/ /klu sogs sgrub la'ang gsang chen don/ /rtogs pa dgos na ha cang thal/ /sngags dang sman gyis chags sogs dag /'phel dang 'grib mthong sngags kyis ni/ /sdang bar byed phyir des de ni/ /mi spongs zhes pa'ang 'thad par dka'/ /sa bon spong zhes kho bo'ang min/ /byams sogs bzhin du bsten par byed/ /de phyir sngags dang sbyor ba yis/ /sdig pa spyod la dga' bar rigs/ /rig sngags spyod pa'i mthu kho na/ /phun tshogs thams cad mthong ba yin/ /45 log par smra ba sna tshogs pa dgag pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //sngags shes gnas pa'i ri bo ru/ /tā ra nā thas brjod pa ste/ /gang na gsang sngags spyod pa der/ /dam chos yun ring gnas par byed/ /zhib mo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa rang lo nyer lnga pa la'o// //shu bhamastu sarba dzā ga taṃ/ 'dir smras pa/ tshad dang ldan pa'i slob dpon 'gas/ /rnam par dpyad pa'ang yongs rig cing*/ /rgyud sde kun gyi gnad shes nas/ /rab byed 'di ni sbyar ba yin/ /zer zlos yang yang ma bskyar bar/ /dgag sgrub rigs pa gsar ba'i tshogs/ /dus mthar 'byung 'di ya mtshan to/ /mkhas rnams rjes su yi rang byos/ /tshigs bcad 'di tsam sbyar bas kyang*/ /gang gi blo gros dpag yas pa/ /mtshon par byas pa ma yin nam/ /blo ldan rnams kyis drang por smros/ /sngags la dad pa mang na yang*/ /rgyu mtshan shes pa nyung ba'i phyir/ /blun dad tsam la mi 'jog na/ /rigs pa 'di la lan brgyar sbyongs/ /shes rab che zhing blo drang ba/

/rnam dpyod ldan pa 'ga' yod na/ kho bo'i legs bshad gsar ba la/ /legs so mgrin gcig sbyin par 'os/ /gzhung 'di sngon dus bzang po'i tshe/ /brtsams na rgya bod gang du yang*/ /dam pa thams cad dgyes 'gyur mod/ /blun po rnams la ci cha yod/ /da lta dus kyi skyon nyid kyis/ /phal cher rmongs shing shes ldan 'ga'/ /phyogs 'dzin phrag dog gis bslad pas/ /'byor ldan lan gyi legs smras spong*/ /ngan du zer yang kho bos ni/ /brag cha bzhin du rtogs mod kyis/ /legs bshad chos la bstod byas na/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar bar 'gyur/ /100 aṅga yang bshad pa/ zhus dag /bkra shis/ /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/zhib mo rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 368 -- PAGE 369 -- PAGE 350 -
